verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents native, auditor-vetted integrations that collect compliance data automatically and satisfy evidence requests directly. Monitors check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP, and integrations refresh data up to daily or ad-hoc, which covers the scheduled, machine-gathered core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that collected artifacts are timestamped, documentation that they replace screenshots/CSV uploads, detail on the per-integration evidence format, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
